caption: The video captures a wide daytime railway scene with two red-orange tied-arch bridges carrying the railway line against green mountains and a clear blue sky. A long white passenger train moves steadily rightward along an elevated concrete viaduct at the left and across the larger foreground arch bridge. Its visible section on the viaduct shifts right while the train remains partly outside the frame, and a white train section on the smaller background arch bridge advances rightward as well. The still foreground water mirrors the bridges, sky, and moving trains, so the reflections slide rightward along the surface. The mountains, single cloud, bridge structures, and viaduct piers hold fixed positions across the view. The camera remains essentially static, leaving the trains' lateral passage as the main visible motion.
